chats.answer:
Lithium-battery golf carts are a great option if you're looking for an electric golf cart with longer battery life, faster charging, and less maintenance than traditional lead-acid models.

Most modern lithium golf carts use 48V or 72V LiFePO4 batteries.

What to look for

Feature

	

Recommendation




Battery

	

LiFePO4 (lithium iron phosphate)




Voltage

	

48V or 72V




Range

	

30–60 miles, depending on model




Charging

	

Typically 3–6 hours




Seating

	

2, 4, or 6 passengers




Battery lifespan

	

Often 2,000–4,000+ cycles




Warranty

	

Prefer 5–8 years of battery coverage
